faq.q: How long do NOORÉ candles burn?
faq.a: Petite 18–20 hours, Classic 42–52 hours, Grand 80–110 hours depending on the collection. Trim the wick to 5 mm before each light for the cleanest, longest burn.

faq.q: Why is my first burn important?
faq.a: Wax has memory. Let the melt pool reach the edge of the vessel on the first burn (2–3 hours) and it will burn evenly for the rest of its life. Blow it out early and it may tunnel.

faq.q: Can I refill or reuse the vessel?
faq.a: Please do. Freeze the vessel for an hour, pop out the remaining wax, wash with warm soapy water. Our marble and glass vessels make excellent planters, brush holders and catch-alls.
